title: EXCLUSIVE: Van Dang Fragrances Expands Its Retail Footprint
summary: The scent brand, cofounded by Kim-Van Dang and her husband, Anthony Roberts, is debuting its full assortment in two Saks doors.

extraction.key_fact: Van Dang Fragrances가 전체 제품군을 Saks 두 매장에서 선보인다.
